title: What It Takes: Oprah Winfrey, Part 1 (1/4)
titleZh: What It Takes：歐普拉，第一部分 (1/4)
summaryZh: 這集節目先播出多段人生體悟的話語，再介紹本集主角歐普拉。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — What It Takes

sentences.text: Adam A., this child is gifted, and I heard that enough that I started to believe it.
sentences.zh: Adam A.，這孩子很有天分，這種話我聽多了，久了自己也開始相信。

sentences.text: If you have the opportunity, not a perfect opportunity, and you don't take it, you may never have another chance.
sentences.zh: 如果機會來了，就算不是完美的機會，你卻沒有把握住，可能就再也沒有下一次了。

sentences.text: It was just like the picture started to form itself.
sentences.zh: 就好像那幅畫面自己慢慢成形一樣。

sentences.text: There was no way in which a lie could prevail over the truth, darkness over light, death over life.
sentences.zh: 謊言不可能勝過真相，黑暗不可能勝過光明，死亡也不可能勝過生命。

sentences.text: Every day I wake up and decide, today I'm going to love my life.
sentences.zh: 我每天醒來都會決定，今天我要好好愛我的人生。

sentences.text: My advice is, if they're going to break your leg once when you go in that place, stay out of there.
sentences.zh: 我的建議是，如果你每次進那個地方都會被打斷一次腿，那就別再進去了。

sentences.text: And then along come these differential experiences that you don't look for, you don't plan for, but boy, you better not miss them.
sentences.zh: 然後就會出現一些你沒去找、也沒計畫過的特別經歷，但天啊，你千萬別錯過。

sentences.text: Welcome to another episode of What It Takes, a podcast about passion, vision, and perseverance from the Academy of Achievement's recorded collection.
sentences.zh: 歡迎收聽新一集的《What It Takes》，這是一個關於熱情、遠見和毅力的節目，內容取自 Academy of Achievement 的錄音典藏。

sentences.text: On every episode of What It Takes, we play you a revealing conversation with someone who has literally changed the world.
sentences.zh: 在《What It Takes》的每一集裡，我們都會播出一段深入的對談，訪問真正改變了世界的人。

sentences.text: And mind you, a lot of people say literally these days when they mean figuratively, but I mean literally, literally.
sentences.zh: 提醒一下，現在很多人嘴上說「真的」，其實只是比喻，但我說的「真的」，是字面上的真的。

sentences.text: The Academy of Achievement has been recording these conversations for decades to document the extraordinary lives of people like Bill Gates, Alan Shepard, and Hank Aaron.
sentences.zh: Academy of Achievement 幾十年來一直在錄下這些對談，記錄像 Bill Gates、Alan Shepard 和 Hank Aaron 這些人不凡的一生。

sentences.text: But mostly to show that all of us can learn what it takes to do a little better, aim a little higher.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是要讓大家知道，我們每個人都能學會怎麼做得更好一點、把目標放得更高一點。

sentences.text: There is arguably no one alive who has built a bigger empire of inspiration than Oprah Winfrey.
sentences.zh: 在世的人當中，大概沒有人打造出比歐普拉更龐大的勵志王國。
